description: The signed-in driver's own parking: recent sessions (newest first), spaces held through this connector, and monthly passes, each with a link to its page on parkgraph.com. Requires driver sign-in to Park Graph through this connector; without sign-in the call answers 401 with the sign-in details. Sessions are matched by the driver's verified sign-in email (the email on their receipts). get_session checks one session without sign-in, by phone code. Every payment completes on parkgraph.com with the driver present; no tool charges money on its own.

active_only.description: Only sessions that are parked now and holds that haven't expired
